name: O'Reilly Auto Parts
old_description: O’Reilly Auto Parts offers free battery testing for cars, trucks, SUVs, commercial and heavy-duty vehicles, and powersport batteries. Batteries can be tested in or out of the vehicle and charged in the store if needed. If you need a new battery, one of our parts professionals will help you find the right one for your vehicle and budget.
about:
O'Reilly Auto Parts operates store #2814 at 3009 NE 72nd Drive in Vancouver, Washington. The location is part of the national O'Reilly Auto Parts chain, a publicly traded automotive aftermarket retailer founded in 1957, though the specific founding date of this Vancouver store is not disclosed in the available information. The store serves the greater Clark County area with extended daily hours, opening at 7:30 AM most days and closing at 10 PM, with reduced Sunday hours from 8 AM to 8 PM.

The Vancouver store stocks a broad inventory of replacement parts and maintenance items for passenger cars, light trucks, SUVs, heavy-duty commercial vehicles, powersport machines, marine applications, and lawn-and-garden equipment. Core categories include brake pads, rotors, calipers, and hardware; radiators, thermostats, and cooling-system components; shocks, struts, and suspension parts; as well as tools, shop supplies, and detailing products. In addition to parts sales, the location provides a suite of free diagnostic and installation services: battery testing and charging, alternator and starter testing, check-engine-light code scanning with the VeriScan tool, headlight and wiper-blade installation with purchase, used-oil and battery recycling, a loaner-tool program covering more than 80 specialty tools, and in-store brake drum and rotor resurfacing.

Customers range from do-it-yourself vehicle owners to professional repair shops and fleet operators who need immediate access to parts and on-site services. The store supports both walk-in and online ordering with free next-day delivery and free in-store pickup, allowing commercial accounts and retail buyers to source components without waiting for shipment from distant warehouses.

The company emphasizes convenience and technical support as its primary differentiators, positioning each location as a one-stop resource where parts availability, diagnostic assistance, and tool access converge to reduce vehicle downtime.
